name: sheetsdata-mcp-bundle-runtime
description: Runtime package.json for the DXT/MCPB bundle's node_modules — not published. Committed (with its lockfile) so scripts/build-mcpb.sh can `npm ci` a byte-for-byte reproducible node_modules instead of floating mcp-remote's transitive deps on every build. Its mcp-remote pin and `version` must match the root package.json; scripts/versions.mjs enforces both.
